parsed.reason: The message states facts flatly with no attribution to a look already taken. "Markham Fall 2026 registration opens Aug 11" and "Angus Glen has Family swim Sunday" are presented as bare information with nothing in the opening to signal these came from work Hale already did for this family. There's no half-clause in the first sentence folding in that Hale checked - the first sentence launches straight into the fact. The residentNote and other context appear to come from looking, but the message doesn't embed evidence of that search into its opening. A reader cannot distinguish this from trivia a stranger sent.
